headerDisplay: Exposes the Pi's HDMI-CEC TV to HomeKit as a Television accessory (power, input switching, and remote-key navigation of the PiTV menu). Published as an external accessory so it appears as a TV tile, not inside the bridge. Commands are signed with a key shared with tv_menu.py — deploy.sh writes it to /etc/pitv/control.key and adds the Homebridge user to the 'pitv' group; set controlKey below only if this plugin cannot read that file.

name.title: TV Name
name.description: The name shown on the TV tile in the Home app.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Selectable inputs. Each sends a raw CEC frame when chosen. Defaults to HDMI 1/2 using the standard Active-Source frames.

controlKeyFile.title: Control key file
controlKeyFile.description: Path to the shared control key. Leave blank to use /etc/pitv/control.key.

controlKey.title: Control key (paste)
controlKey.description: The key itself, from `screen control key show`. Only needed if Homebridge cannot read the key file. Treat it as a password.
